pwd && printf '

' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && printf '
--- alphametics.go ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' alphametics.go 2>/dev/null || true && printf '
--- tests ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' alphametics_test.go 2>/dev/null || true && printf '
--- go.mod ---
' && cat go.mod 2>/dev/null || true
cd /exercise && printf '%s\n' '--- cases_test.go ---' && sed -n '1,500p' cases_test.go && printf '%s\n' '--- git status ---' && git status --short 2>/dev/null || true

cd /exercise && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('cases_test.go').read()
inputs=re.findall(r'\binput:\s+"([^"]*)"',s)
for idx,puz in enumerate(inputs):
    left,right=puz.split('==')
    addends=[w.strip() for w in left.split('+')]
    result=right.strip()
    maxlen=max(map(len,addends+[result]))
    print('CASE',idx,'addends',len(addends),'maxlen',maxlen,'resultlen',len(result))
    if idx==len(inputs)-1:
        for col in range(maxlen):
            counts={}
            for w in addends:
                pos=len(w)-1-col
                if pos>=0: counts[w[pos]]=counts.get(w[pos],0)+1
            tgt=result[len(result)-1-col] if col<len(result) else '-'
            print(' col',col,'nterms',sum(counts.values()),'counts',dict(sorted(counts.items())),'target',tgt)
PY
